Third person singular -s · 高频真题(第3轮): Present simple with third person singular subjects: the verb changes, add -s/-es to the base form.本课为高频真题练习,核心:When he/she/it or a singular noun is the subject, the verb adds -s/-es。

Most verbs add -s: reads, works|Those ending in s/x/ch/sh add -es: watches, washes|Consonant + y changes y to i and adds -es: studies|have changes specially to has|The negative is doesn't + base verb (not doesn'ts)
She read books every night.|She reads books every night.|She reading books every night.|She reades books every night.
column4: 考查When he/she/it or a singular noun is the subject, the verb adds -s/-es。正确句:She reads books every night.
